title: Lewis Pullman
premise_summary: Lewis James Pullman is an American actor. He made his film debut opposite his father Bill Pullman in The Ballad of Lefty Brown (2017). For his performance as Miles Miller in the thriller Bad Times at the El Royale (2018), Pullman was nominated for the Saturn Award for Best Supporting Actor. Pullman subsequently had supporting roles in films such as The Strangers: Prey at Night (2018), Them That Follow (2019), Top Gun: Maverick (2022), and Riff Raff (2024), as well as lead roles in Press Play (2022), The Starling Girl (2023), 'Salem's Lot, and Skincare. He gained international recognition for his role as Sentry in the Marvel Cinematic Universe film Thunderbolts* (2025) and is set to reprise the role in Avengers: Doomsday (2026).
